qualifications.note: A space is a forbidden host code point (WHATWG URL host parser): the engine fails, as the spec and WPT require; Chromium percent-encodes it.
"|" is outside the path percent-encode set: the engine keeps it, as the spec does; Chromium encodes it as %7C.
The engine keeps the drive letter case of file:c: oo; Chromium uppercases it.
The spec file-host state replaces the host "localhost" with the empty host: the engine does; Chromium keeps localhost.
The protocol setter cannot turn a non-special scheme into a special one: the engine keeps mailto:, as the spec does; Chromium switches to https.
Setting search to "?" sets an empty query, so href keeps the "?" (spec); Chromium drops it.
